translations.web: That which enters into the mouth doesn’t defile the man; but that which proceeds out of the mouth, this defiles the man.”
translations.bsb: A man is not defiled by what enters his mouth, but by what comes out of it.”
translations.kjv: Not that which goeth into the mouth defileth a man; but that which cometh out of the mouth, this defileth a man.
translations.asv: Not that which entereth into the mouth defileth the man; but that which proceedeth out of the mouth, this defileth the man.
